features.name: Trinity River Audubon visitor center
features.description: The visitor center is the required arrival and check-in point with exhibits, staff guidance, restrooms, water, and broad habitat views; rental closures can shorten exhibit access.
features.source_label: National Audubon Society and City of Dallas

features.name: Trinity River Overlook Trail
features.description: The Trinity River overlook route leads toward views of the river and floodplain over natural surfaces that may close after rain.
features.source_label: National Audubon Society and City of Dallas

features.name: Wetland Trail
features.description: The wetland route passes ponds and seasonal water used by birds, amphibians, and insects; remain on trail and expect mud and limited shade.
features.source_label: National Audubon Society and City of Dallas

features.name: Prairie Trail
features.description: Prairie paths cross open habitat with strong sun, grasses, birds, and seasonal wildflowers; carry water and sun protection.
features.source_label: National Audubon Society and City of Dallas

features.name: Forest Trail
